Name: Farmhouse 1.5 for mobile
Author: Yukini700
Description:
[size=3]I know the mobile gamer's dream is the 1.5 update. Unfortunately, most modders are dedicated to the new update, completely forgetting about mobile players. With that, it took me a while and made a mod that is FULLY compatible with version 1.4 mobile. This mod features the 1.5 main house with some additions like an attic, functional bathroom and a small greenhouse. This is my first Mod, I hope you like it. Any problems, let me know on the forum
